Subject: Order form redlines and tax routing questions

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the draft Order Form. We reviewed the payments and tax sections with our finance team and have three asks before we can route for signature: 

1) Net terms change: CFO wants Net 45 (we usually run Net 45 for enterprise vendors). Can you confirm if Redwood will accept Net 45 for a committed annual volume?
2) Invoice entity: Pioneer Health US vs Pioneer Health Services, Inc. We prefer invoices to go to the US entity (accounting@pioneerhealth.com) — please confirm the remit-to and W‑9/Tax IDs will match that entity.
3) VAT / Withholding: for cross-border services, we need evidence Redwood will not apply EU VAT or, if applicable, provide VAT invoices. Also, please confirm responsibility for any withholding taxes in APAC deployments.

I've attached our redlines (Pioneer_Redlines_20260607.docx). We didn't change price slabs, but we added a clause requesting an invoicing cadence aligned to milestone delivery (monthly invoice cap = $250k).

Can we get a short call to resolve these points? Ideally before we prepare the PO.

Best,
Amanda Cruz
Head of Procurement
Pioneer Health Systems

Amanda / Tessa —

Appreciate the clear items. Quick commercial position so we can move the call to resolution: 

1) Net45: acceptable if Pioneer signs to a minimum annual commit of $1,000,000 and pays 10% (USD) at contract execution as an upfront credit — this offsets cashflow and keeps unit economics intact.
2) Invoicing cadence: we can support monthly invoicing with a monthly invoice cap of $250k as requested; however we'd prefer the contract to keep an annual commitment floor to avoid mid-year scope gaps.
3) Entity & tax evidence: we'll route to the US entity once we have the W‑9 and EIN. For VAT — Redwood will issue VAT invoices where required but needs Pioneer to supply EU VAT registration if you're claiming exemption. For APAC withholding, responsibility normally sits with the customer per local law unless we agree otherwise in the Order Form.

I attached a redlined Order Form (OrderForm_v4_redlined.pdf) with the Net45 / upfront 10% language inserted as a conditional clause. Kim — please add any mandatory tax evidence lines and confirm the SOW invoicing routing language.

If that sounds OK to Pioneer, we can prepare a DocuSign package and Ben will coordinate accounting handoff for PO acceptance.

Thanks,

Amanda / team —

Thanks — a few tax/ops clarifications from our side: 

• W-9 / EIN: to issue invoices to Pioneer Health US we need the signed W‑9 and the exact billing remit address. Please send those to accounting@redwood.com.
• VAT evidence: if Pioneer wants Redwood to zero-rate EU VAT, please provide your EU VAT registration number and the local tax residency certificate. We'll return an EU VAT invoice as required.
• Withholding in APAC: if Pioneer anticipates APAC withholding, please flag the countries and we will expose a clause that says: "Customer is responsible for any taxes, duties, or withholdings imposed by Customer's jurisdiction; Redwood will provide gross-up language on request." That preserves our pricing unless we explicitly accept gross-up.
• Invoice metadata: include PO number on every invoice, and confirm whether Pioneer requires invoice split by product/feature line items (yes/no). If you require split, there may be a small ops fee for itemization to map to your internal GL.

Next steps: Amanda, if you can confirm PO number format and provide W‑9 + VAT number (if applicable) I'll attach the tax evidence zip (Tax_Evidence_Pioneer.zip) to the DocuSign packet and we can finalize signatures. Hoping to close by Wednesday.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
